messages:
elaine: FYI legal approved the deprecation banner text. We still need: (A) quick migration checklist, (B) redirects + redirect smoke tests, (C) snippet fixes for SDKs and samples. Target publish Fri 15:00 UTC.
ben: I'll run a grep across docs + samples for /v1/ endpoints and legacy model ids, output CSV with file:path:line. Will prioritize embed examples and JS/TS snippets.
ashok: note: alias swaps changed a few embed dims (1536 -> 1024). Ben, please flag any example that assumes vector length. Add a console check snippet to the guide.
sam: on SDKs: param rename means some client libs will require users to pass explicit { input: } instead of positional args. I suggest adding a small compatibility snippet that maps old callsites to new payload shape. Mark it "temporary".
ben: drafted compatibility snippet (JS):
```
// compatibility shim - for docs only. remove after migration
function normalizeRequest(req){
  if (Array.isArray(req)) return { input: req };
  if (req.content && !req.input) req.input = req.content;
  return req;
}
await client.invoke(normalizeRequest(userReq));
```
ben: I'll add this to the migration guide under "temporary compatibility helpers".
docs-bot: PR opened redwood/docs#7120 by @ben — "migration checklist + compatibility snippets" (CI: pending) :github: 
maria: small ops ask: Dedicated customers might have pinned weights. We need a clear rollback code path and contact steps for infra. Add a "pin to legacy" snippet and an infra contact template.
nashok: rollout QA: I built a docs CI matrix that runs canonical snippets against staging-v1 and staging-v2 and validates outputs: generation shape, embed vector length, and streaming continuity. I'll add the job to docs CI.
niraj: QA will run smoke tests overnight. Add failure thresholds: > 1% snippet failures -> hold publish. Post failures with file + error snippet.
ben: grep results attached in PR — 89 occurrences, 12 definitely need manual edits (mobile SDKs, tutorial, two sample apps). I'll open per-repo PRs.
els: (typo on my last comment)
elaine: :laughing: typo noted. Back to task — please ensure migration checklist includes: SDK upgrade table (versions that break), embed dim FAQ, console debug curl, and how redirects will report 301->new-model.
sam: also add explicit note to NOT recommend long-lived shims; show short-term example and a clear migration path.
ben: PRs opened for samples: redwood/sample-next#90, redwood/sample-python#55, redwood/mobile-examples#12. docs-bot: sample PRs linked in docs PR description.
docs-bot: CI job docs/migration-matrix started.
niraj: running smoke matrix now. Early results: 2/46 snippets fail — both are mobile examples hitting positional arg deprecation. I've filed issues in the mobile repos and assigned to @ben.
ben: fixing mobile examples now and adding explicit note in mobile README about SDK bump.
nashok: redirect map draft pushed to internal/redirects.md: /models/legacy-embed -> legacy-embed-1024-v2, /models/old-chat -> chat-balanced-v2. Add this to the migration guide and to console alias docs.
elaine: good. Who's owning publish orchestration? I can merge once CI green at 14:30 UTC and schedule the banner for 15:00 UTC. Email send after banner live.
maria: partner outreach: I'll coordinate partner-success for top 20 accounts and create a short checklist they can run during upgrade calls.
ben: CI green on sample PRs except mobile; mobile fixes in flight. docs-bot: docs CI rerun queued.
niraj: rerun results: all snippets passed in smoke matrix (46/46) after mobile fixes. Recording results to /docs/test-results/migration/6481234567.json.
docs-bot: redwood/docs#7120 merged to staging. redirect deploy scheduled. :white_check_mark: 
sam: final doc note: add a quick "how we tested" section describing the smoke matrix so customers can reproduce locally if needed.
elaine: agreed. final step: merge to prod at 14:30 UTC if no regressions. Thanks team — this was thorough and clear.
